front: When and where was the OAU founded?
When was the African Union launched?
Where was the OAU Liberation Committee based?

back: The OAU principle that states should not intervene in the internal affairs of other members.
The AU principle allowing intervention in a member state in cases of war crimes, genocide and crimes against humanity.

front: What were the Casablanca and Monrovia groups?
back: Casablanca (e.g. Nkrumah's Ghana) wanted rapid political union; Monrovia wanted loose co-operation respecting sovereignty. The OAU was the compromise.

front: Name four organs of the OAU.
back: Assembly of Heads of State and Government; Council of Ministers; General Secretariat; Commission of Mediation, Conciliation and Arbitration.

front: Give three failures of the OAU.
back: Inaction over internal conflicts (Biafra, Amin, Rwanda); no army; shortage of money and divisions (Morocco left in 1984).

front: Give three achievements of the AU.
back: Peace missions (Darfur, Somalia); suspension of coup governments; Agenda 2063 and the African Continental Free Trade Area.
